title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE BOARD OF WATER AND POWER COMMISSIONERS (BOARD), EXEMPTION and ORDINANCE FIRST CONSIDERATION relative to amending the Los Angeles…
text:
[Council File 26-1564]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE BOARD OF WATER AND POWER COMMISSIONERS (BOARD), EXEMPTION and ORDINANCE FIRST CONSIDERATION relative to amending the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC) to clarify prohibited uses and modify certain water conservation requirements of the Water Conservation Plan of the City.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. DETERMINE that the adoption of the draft ordinance is not subject to California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA). Pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3), an activity is not subject to CEQA if it does not meet the definition of a project. CEQA Guidelines Section 15378(b)(5) states that organizational or administrative activities that will not result in direct or indirect physical changes in the environment are not a project. The draft ordinance consists of administrative and enforcement-related modifications. These changes will not result in a direct or reasonably foreseeable indirect physical change in the environment.
2. CONCUR with the Board action of October 27, 2026, Resolution No. 027-065, which approves Proposed Amendments to the Emergency Water Conservation Ordinance.
3. PRESENT and ADOPT the accompanying ORDINANCE dated November 8, 2026, amending Article I of Chapter XII of the LAMC to clarify prohibited uses and modify certain water conservation requirements of the Water Conservation Plan of the City.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the Board. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Energy and Environment Committee waived consideration of the above matter.)
